questions.question: Is titanium considered a toxic metal?
questions.answer: Titanium is listed among minor toxic metals for which toxicity has been described, according to [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]]. Beyond that classification, this wiki page does not yet detail specific health effects or exposure levels for titanium. It is a source-map stub, so substantive titanium-specific information is still pending a dedicated review of the literature.

questions.question: Why does this titanium page have so little information?
questions.answer: This page is a source-map stub created during the re-ingest of [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]], which mentions titanium only in passing. It currently serves as source-map context, and substantive titanium-specific expansion awaits a dedicated ingest. In other words, the wiki has not yet compiled a full review of titanium-specific studies.

questions.question: Are titanium implants mentioned in the context of metal toxicity?
questions.answer: Yes. The chapter by [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]] mentions titanium-based implants within the broader discussion of metal-therapy and implant toxicity. The wiki records this as context but does not yet provide detailed findings on implant-related titanium effects.

questions.question: What sources does this page rely on for titanium information?
questions.answer: The page currently draws on a single source, [[sources/ufelle2021-metals-chapter|Ufelle & Barchowsky 2021]], the chapter Toxic Effects of Metals in Casarett & Doull's Essentials of Toxicology, 4th edition. This is the only reference cited, which is why the page is marked as a stub awaiting further ingest.
